description: Calculate Pakistan property taxes using the Chakor Ventures WordPress FBR Property Tax Calculator FY 2025-26 methodology. Automatically returns Section 236K purchase advance tax, Section 236C sale advance tax, and Section 37 capital gains tax in one result. Uses the website's customised rates and simplified CGT rules, not independently verified current FBR rates.

acquisitionDate.description: Property acquisition date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required to calculate CGT.

overseasPakistani.description: Whether the taxpayer is an overseas Pakistani

primaryResidence.description: Whether the property is the taxpayer's primary residence

propertyType.description: Type of property for capital gains tax calculation

propertyValue.description: Property value according to FBR valuation in PKR

purchasePrice.description: Original property purchase price in PKR

taxpayerStatus.description: Taxpayer status: Filer, Late Filer, or Non-Filer

name: estimate_property_tax
